dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Rapid and symmetrical linear convergence of the lateral margins from the mid-body toward the posterior, creating a distinct triangular geometry.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; high-reflectance intensity on the surfaced dorsal plane with a distinct value shift to blue-grey in submerged regions.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Sharp, high-contrast gradient along the longitudinal dorsal ridge separating the surfaced epidermis from the submerged lateral flanks.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent, elevated longitudinal dorsal ridge creating a distinct peak along the central axis of the visible body mass.
